## SK Hynix Approves ₩54 Trillion New Memory Fab; Valuation Upside Case Floated by One Outlet

A ₩54 trillion fab commitment by the HBM market leader is the most significant memory capex signal of the current cycle, locking in SK Hynix's supply posture through the mid-decade and directly informing competitive dynamics against Samsung and Micron in HBM.

- SK Hynix's board has approved a ₩54 trillion investment in a new memory fabrication facility.
- The investment scale represents a major capacity commitment that could extend SK Hynix's lead in high-bandwidth memory.
- One outlet (simplywall.st) argues SK Hynix could be significantly undervalued — citing 48% — following the announcement; this is a single-source valuation claim.
- The headline pair reflects both a strategic news event and a secondary valuation debate triggered by it.
